en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a round stone tower with small windows and a steep conical roof, standing on a grassy hill lined with trees. A paved path curves in the foreground where people in mid‑20th‑century clothing are walking. In the background, partly hidden by trees, are onion-domed church towers characteristic of Eastern Orthodox architecture. The sky is filled with long, streaked clouds. There is a narrow white margin around the image and some catalog-style writing along the right edge.
